drafts.passage: Across the five tabular benchmarks, Fernwood achieved a higher mean test AUROC (81.2) than Quillgate-GBDT (80.3), with Fernwood outperforming Quillgate-GBDT on four of the five datasets (Alder-Credit, Birchfield-Churn, Cobalt-Insure, and Edgerton-Default). The exception was Dunmore-Fraud, where Quillgate-GBDT achieved a higher AUROC (93.5) than Fernwood (91.1). No statistical significance tests were reported, so these differences should be interpreted as descriptive only.
